name: choice
title: Choice
description: A radio or checkbox option large enough to explain itself.
use: An option that needs a title and a sentence: a plan, a payment method, a setting. It is a label around a native radio, checkbox or switch, and it reads its state from that input.

instead.when: A short label is enough and one option can be chosen
A short label is enough and any number can be chosen
There are more options than fit on the page
Choosing an answer should show how everyone answered

keyboard.action: Move the choice along radios that share a name
Toggles the checkbox or the switch inside, or chooses the focused radio

classes.name: choice
classes.description: The option, on a label around a radio, a checkbox or a switch; the focus ring is drawn around the whole option

classes.name: choice-body
classes.description: The words: a title and an optional description, on one edge

classes.name: choice-description
classes.description: One muted sentence under the title, inside choice-body

classes.name: choice-end
classes.description: A price, a badge or a figure at the end of the first line

states.name: chosen
states.description: On the input inside: the face rises one step and its contour turns to ink

states.name: disabled
states.description: On the input inside: the face drops to a well with disabled ink

example: Plan
